text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Namibia aims to boost Gulf business links.
- Foreign tourists spent about $870 million in Bahrain in 1995. Bahrain enjoyed $450 million in tourism income in 1995.

- Bahrain's State Security Court on Sunday sentenced three Bahrainis to three years in jail each for arson. A fourth Bahraini was sentenced to three months in prison for possession of propoganda leaflets.
Members of Bahrain's Shi'ite community, who are waging a violent campaign to demand political and economic reforms, have handed out anti-government leaflets.
- Bahrain and Middle East Bank led the Bahrain bourse on Sunday.
